metadata.name: stage4-routeros-rfc99-gateway-deployment
metadata.description: Render and review the physical CCR2004 RouterOS RFC99 gateway replacement configuration before any live import.

variables.name: ansible_root
variables.description: Ansible subtree containing the RouterOS RFC99 gateway playbook and role.

variables.name: inventory
variables.description: Inventory containing the routeros_rfc99_gateways host group.

variables.name: render_root
variables.description: Local filesystem location where the role renders the .rsc file and JSON manifest.

stages.summary: Validate the RouterOS RFC99 gateway playbook syntax before touching the RouterOS host.
Render the CCR2004 RouterOS .rsc configuration and JSON manifest locally without applying them.
Review generated RouterOS commands, cabling assumptions, service restrictions, and rollback path before live serial import.
command: printf 'Review rendered CCR2004 RSC: sfp-sfpplus1 WAN, sfp-sfpplus2 LAN trunk, ge1-ge16 renames, SSH/HTTPS/API-SSL only, self-signed cert, VLAN plan, normalized overlapping prefixes.\n'

stages.summary: Document the explicit live-apply gate; this workflow does not mutate RouterOS.
command: printf 'No live apply is implemented. Keep serial console open, export backups, then add a gated serial/SSH import stage only after review.\n'
